name: Urine rate
eligibility: Complete nonoverlapping urine intervals, mapped units, >0 duration/weight, assessed patency/losses; no chart timestamp duration inference.

name: Creatinine absolute change
eligibility: Distinct eligible specimens and exact <=48h interval. Versioned conversion only; uncertainty retained.

name: Creatinine baseline ratio
eligibility: Eligible positive baseline and comparable units with known/presumed onset context; no back-calculated baseline.

name: Timed measured CrCl
eligibility: Matching concentration dimensions, complete collection, representative plasma sample, >0 denominator; label CrCl rather than GFR.

name: BSA deindexing
eligibility: Source indexed estimate and explicitly selected eligible BSA; output mL/min and method limitations.

name: FENa
eligibility: Paired eligible sample times/units; diuretics, sepsis, CKD and other limits; no etiology classifier.

name: FEurea
eligibility: Same species for urea/BUN or explicit approved conversion; paired samples, denominator >0 and confounders.

name: Measured effluent rate
eligibility: Nonduplicated actual measurements/counter deltas, resets validated and reporting coverage complete.

name: Estimated effluent volume
eligibility: Piecewise confirmed actual segments; machine-specific accounting includes each flow once; not a measured volume.

name: Wall-time normalized effluent
eligibility: Label measured/estimated basis, total elapsed denominator and unknown coverage; known downtime contributes zero only if confirmed.

name: On-treatment normalized effluent
eligibility: Distinct label from wall-time dose; do not compare on-treatment value to a wall-time target silently.

name: Downtime and coverage
eligibility: Clip to explicit window; reject impossible/ambiguous ordering; overlap union, not sum.

name: Predilution modeled surrogate
formula: profile-specific plasma-flow dilution model, for example Qp/(Qp+Qpre), Qp=Qb*(1-Hct)
eligibility: Qb and Qpre same volume/time units, fractional Hct, replacement site and convective/diffusive assumptions. Illustrative model only; not one universal CVVHDF correction.

name: Solute-specific clearance
eligibility: Representative paired specimens, >0 plasma concentration and modality-specific method; surrogate uncertainty explicit.

name: Systemic calcium ratio
eligibility: Matched site/time/quality, compatible units; calcium mg/dL conversion requires validated species-specific factor. No postfilter substitution.

name: Filtration fraction
eligibility: Define denominator/replacement position, blood units/Hct, UF species, membrane model; no universal limit or one formula across all circuits.

name: Patient extracorporeal net removal
eligibility: Positive-removal convention stated. Patient-balance accounting and machine balance differ; no subtraction of already included replacement twice.

name: PD exchange net UF
eligibility: Same exchange and complete recovery; leaks/residual volume/unknowns block authoritative total.

name: Filter life
eligibility: Report wall-time and runtime separately; censored open circuits and reason retained.

name: URR and Kt/V
formula: Exact selected validated intermittent adequacy formula/profile
eligibility: Appropriate pre/post urea technique, time, weight/UF and rebound semantics. Not implemented from memory; no CRRT substitution.

name: Drug-specific eCrCl/eGFR
formula: Exact label/formulary-required equation and population profile
eligibility: Full demographics, assay and weight/BSA applicability; unstable renal function flags; no automatic choice.

name: CKD-EPI/cystatin/kinetic estimates
eligibility: Reference coefficients and full eligibility from published original method; kinetic estimates distinct, not assumed equivalent for dosing.

name: Electrolyte/nutrient losses
eligibility: Measured loss versus modelled loss separately, correct dimensions, sampling coverage and no generic concentration assumptions.

name: Glucose/citrate substrate contribution
formula: product concentration * actual delivered volume * explicitly selected uptake/metabolism/energy model
eligibility: Product role/species, effluent removal and metabolic uncertainty; no complete citrate metabolism or automatic addition to M14 intake.
